'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jerry Heine DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jerry Heine]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Why do I have a t-shirt cannon?
* '''Username:''' Queso
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
